assertions.name: borromean_proton_evolved_fl_mellin_moments_positivity_and_uv_softening
assertions.source: 1-loop singlet/non-singlet DGLAP evolution of QOU Borromean [u,u,d] moments across Q^2 in {4, 20, 100, M_Z^2} GeV^2

description: 80-dps verification of chiral Weyl-Dirac Clifford algebra and 256-component 4-gamma traces, spin-1/2 1+(1-y)^2 vs spin-0 2(1-y) DIS contractions and Callan-Gross relation F_2 = 2x F_1, 1-loop QCD longitudinal F_L Mellin moments (n = 2, 3, 4) evolved from QOU Borromean proton moments, and worldline 1 - exp(-2 Q^2 / E_Pl^2) UV bounds across HERA and LHC.
q0AnchorReason: Evaluates q-independent chiral Weyl-Dirac Clifford traces, Callan-Gross partonic contractions, and Planck worldline UV bounds alongside 1-loop QCD longitudinal F_L Mellin moments evolved from QOU Borromean proton moments side-by-side across {q_0, q_2t, q_muon}.
